```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class BookmarkForm extends Component
{
    public $bookmarkId = null;
    public $title;
    public $url;

    public function mount($bookmarkId = null)
    {
        if ($bookmarkId) {
            $this->bookmarkId = $bookmarkId;
            $this->loadBookmark();
        }
    }

    public function loadBookmark()
    {
        // Fetch the bookmark from the database using Auth::user() as the owner
        $this->bookmark = Auth::user()->bookmarks()->find($this->bookmarkId);
        if ($this->bookmark) {
            $this->title = $this->bookmark->title;
            $this->url = $this->bookmark->url;
        }
    }

    public function save()
    {
        // Save the bookmark to the database using Auth::user() as the owner
        $bookmarkedItem = Auth::user()->bookmarks()->create([
            'title' => $this->title,
            'url' => $this->url,
            'owner_id' => Auth::id(),
        ]);
        session()->flash('message', 'Bookmark saved successfully!');
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        // Delete the bookmark from the database using Auth::user() as the owner
        $bookmarkedItem = Auth::user()->bookmarks()->find($this->bookmarkId);
        if ($bookmarkedItem) {
            $bookmarkedItem->delete();
            session()->flash('message', 'Bookmark deleted successfully!');
        }
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.bookmark-form');
    }
}
```
